name: studio
description: Pocket Studio: an installable (PWA) visual site builder with CMS, publishing and custom domains.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @studio/core && npm run build -w @studio/server && npm run build -w @studio/editor
scripts.test: npm run build -w @studio/core && npm run build -w @studio/server && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs apps/server/test/*.test.mjs
